fields.seo_title: University of Glasgow for Indian Students: Fees and IELTS
fields.meta_description: University of Glasgow for Indian students: MSc Computing Science tuition £34,815, IELTS 6.5, two India scholarships and the full first-year cost.
fields.body_md:
## At a glance

The University of Glasgow is in Glasgow, Scotland. Its one-year Master of Science (MSc) in Computing Science is taught at the Gilmorehill campus. Many Indian students look at Glasgow because it offers two scholarships for students from India.

The most important thing to know is the cost. Tuition for international students is **£34,815 a year**. Living money and visa fees come on top, so the first-year total is higher. The worked example below shows the full figure.

| | MSc Computing Science |
|---|---|
| Campus | Gilmorehill, Glasgow |
| Length | 12 months, full time |
| Start | September |
| Tuition for international and EU students | **£34,815** a year (2027-28 fee year) |
| Deposit to secure a place | **£2,000** |
| English test (IELTS) | **6.5** overall. Either Writing is **6.5** and no other part is below **6.0**, or Writing is **6.0** and every other part is **6.5** or higher |

## What it really costs

Tuition is **£34,815** for full-time study in the 2027-28 fee year.

**Deposit.** International and EU applicants pay a **£2,000** deposit to secure a place. The deposit terms are on the university's website. Read them to check when you must pay.

**Living money for the visa.** A UK Student visa needs proof that you can pay for your living costs. Outside London, you must show **£1,171** for each month of your course, for up to **9 months**. You must hold this money for 28 days in a row. The last day of that 28-day period must fall within 31 days of the day you apply.

**The CAS.** A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the document your university issues once it accepts you. You need it for your visa application.

**English for the visa.** The visa also needs English at CEFR level B2 for degree-level study. CEFR is the common scale for language ability, running from A1 to C2.

**The health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a fee you pay with your visa so you can use the NHS, the UK's public health service. It is **£776 for each year of your visa** for students.

### Worked first-year cost: MSc Computing Science

| Item | How it is worked out | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition | Full-time fee, 2027-28 | £34,815 |
| Living money for the visa | £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee | Applying from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge (£776 or more) | £776 for each year of your visa, shown here for one year | £776 or more |
| **Total** | £34,815 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 | **at least £46,688** |

Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164.

This is an example, not a full budget. The £2,000 deposit is not in this total.

For the visa rules in full, read our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare costs with other UK universities, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Ways to reduce the cost

Glasgow has two scholarships for students from India. You cannot use both.

**World Changers India Excellence Award**

- A **£12,500** tuition fee waiver for one year.
- Up to 12 awards for students from India.
- You need a UK first-class equivalent result. The page says this is typically 85% and above.
- You need an offer for September 2027, international fee status, and an Indian passport. You must be domiciled in India, which means India is your permanent home.
- The deadline is **31 March 2027 at 11:45 UK time**. Results come by 14 April 2027.
- The page says applications "will open shortly". Check the page for the application link.

**World Changers Glasgow Scholarship**

- A **£5,000** tuition fee discount.
- It is applied automatically, so you do not apply separately.
- India is on the list of eligible countries.
- You need international fee status and an offer for September 2027 or January 2028.

**The two cannot be combined.** The World Changers Glasgow page says the scholarship "cannot be combined with another University scholarship". The India Excellence Award page says Glasgow discounts cannot be combined with one another, except the Alumni Discount. If you are offered more than one, the lower award is removed. In practice, plan for one of these two awards, not both.

## Getting in

- **Degree.** The course page asks for a 2.1 Honours degree or a non-UK equivalent, in any degree with Computing as a major subject. A 2.1 is a UK upper second-class degree. Ask the university how your Indian marks convert to a 2.1 before you apply.
- **English.** IELTS is an English test with four parts: listening, reading, writing and speaking. You need **6.5** overall. Either Writing is **6.5** and no other part is below **6.0**, or Writing is **6.0** and every other part is **6.5** or higher.

Check the course page for the full entry rules before you apply.

## Deadlines

For September 2027 entry, international applicants apply in rounds.

| Round | Opens | Closes |
|---|---|---|
| Round 1 | 1 Oct 2026 | 5 Nov 2026 |
| Round 2 | 6 Nov 2026 | 17 Dec 2026 |
| Round 3 | 18 Dec 2026 | 4 Feb 2027 |
| Round 4 | 5 Feb 2027 | 25 Mar 2027 |
| Round 5 | 26 Mar 2027 | 13 May 2027 |
| Round 6 | 14 May 2027 | 8 July 2027 |

The last round closes on **8 July 2027**. The MBA closes on **31 July 2027** for all applicants.

Apply early. You can apply for the visa no earlier than 6 months before your course starts. Plan your visa dates around your offer and your CAS.

## Related master's courses

The MSc Computing Science is the main course on this page. Two other Glasgow master's are close to it.

- [MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence](https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/data-science-artificial-intelligence/) uses the same international rounds and the same IELTS rule as Computing Science.
- [MBA](https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/businessadministration/) is a 12-month full-time course. It asks for IELTS 6.5 overall, with no part below 6.0.

## Where you will live

The course is taught at the Gilmorehill campus in Glasgow. Glasgow is the city where you will live while you study.

The university's postgraduate rooms cost from **£141.47 a week** for a Student Apartments twin shared room, up to **£258.72 a week** for a Kelvingrove House studio. These are **2026-27** rates for non-family postgraduate rooms. For 2027-28 prices, check the accommodation fees page.

The university's postgraduate guarantee for offer holders is stated for September 2026 entry. For September 2027, ask the accommodation office. To be told when applications open for session 2027/2028, sign up on the accommodation pages.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- You have a 2.1 Honours degree with Computing as a major subject, or expect one, and can reach IELTS 6.5 overall with the Writing and other part scores the course asks for.
- You want a 12-month full-time MSc in Computing Science that starts in September.
- You can meet the first-class requirement for the India Excellence Award, or the international fee status for the Glasgow scholarship.

**Think carefully if:**

- You cannot show £1,171 a month for up to 9 months, held for 28 days in a row.
- Your Writing score is 6.0. That is allowed only if every other IELTS part is 6.5 or higher.
- You need more funding than one scholarship can give. Check the full cost before you apply.

To compare alternatives, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Sources

Checked on 2026-11-03: [MSc Computing Science](https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/computingscience/), [World Changers India Excellence Award](https://www.gla.ac.uk/scholarships/worldchangersindiaexcellenceaward/), [World Changers Glasgow Scholarship](https://www.gla.ac.uk/scholarships/worldchangersglasgowscholarship/), [Postgraduate accommodation fees](https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/accommodation/fees/), [How to apply for accommodation](https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/accommodation/howtoapplyforaccommodation/), [Postgraduate admissions policy](https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/accommodation/admissionspolicy/postgraduateadmissionspolicy/), [MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence](https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/data-science-artificial-intelligence/), and [MBA](https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/businessadministration/).

Checked on 2026-11-01 (UK government): [Student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa), [Financial evidence for student route applicants](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/financial-evidence-for-student-and-child-student-route-applicants), [Healthcare surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay), and [Knowledge of English](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/knowledge-of-english).

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much is tuition at the University of Glasgow for Indian students?
faq_json.a: For international and EU students, tuition for the MSc Computing Science is £34,815 a year for full-time study in the 2027-28 fee year. The course lasts 12 months.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score do I need for Glasgow's MSc Computing Science?
faq_json.a: You need IELTS 6.5 overall. Either Writing is 6.5 and no other part is below 6.0, or Writing is 6.0 and every other part is 6.5 or higher.

faq_json.q: Does Glasgow give scholarships to students from India?
faq_json.a: Yes, there are two. The World Changers India Excellence Award is a £12,500 tuition fee waiver for one year, with a deadline of 31 March 2027. The World Changers Glasgow Scholarship is a £5,000 tuition fee discount that is applied automatically. You cannot use both.

faq_json.q: How much is the Glasgow tuition deposit?
faq_json.a: International and EU applicants pay a £2,000 deposit to secure a place. Check the deposit terms on the university's website for when you must pay.

faq_json.q: What is the application deadline for Glasgow MSc Computing Science in September 2027?
faq_json.a: International applicants apply in rounds. Round 1 closes on 5 Nov 2026, and the last round closes on 8 July 2027.

faq_json.q: How much money do I need to show for the UK Student visa at Glasgow?
faq_json.a: Outside London, you must show £1,171 for each month of your course, for up to 9 months. For this course that is £10,539, and you must hold it for 28 days in a row.
